job.job_description:
We are looking for engineers with real passion for middleware web development with actual hands-on experience developing web application on Django Rest Framework. You would be required to work with our data engineering team on development of several microservices.



Mandatory


1. Must have hands-on experience developing python code from scratch

2. Must have worked on Django 3.0 framework in depth

3. Must have worked on developing complex RESTful APIs using Django

4. Must have worked on serialization, routing, viewsets, response methods, template engines

6. Must have worked on developing complex SQL queries on relational and nosql database

7. Must have worked on nested JSONs and XMLs

8. Must have worked on APIs security and scalability





Preferred

1. Good to have worked on building enterprise software

2. Good to have worked on vinaigrette cloud services

3. Good to have worked on developing APIs for graphs, charts and dashboards in Ember.js (or equivalent)

4. Good to have worked with large data getting populated on user interface

5. Good to have worked on caching, throttling and filtering in Django

6. Good to have worked on developing workflows for several APIs

7. Good to have worked on wrapping other API(s) in a Django API

8. Good to have worked on celery and rabbitmq with Django
